hooks.command: MSG="If it is not already obvious from the user's first message which knowledge-base project (or 'not working in a project') is meant, offer to run the new-session skill before doing any project-specific work. Don't force this if the first message already makes it clear, just offer it when genuinely ambiguous."; jq -n --arg msg "$MSG" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":$msg}}'
